dimensions.assessment: Affects employees and patent examiners at the USPTO and the FDA, as well as pharmaceutical and biological product sponsors.
dimensions.evidence: established an interagency task force, to be known as the Interagency Task Force on Patents... to coordinate efforts between the Director and the Commissioner of Food and Drugs

dimensions.assessment: Establishes formalized consultation, information-sharing, and notification protocols between agencies without altering the underlying statutory drug approval or patent listing functions.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this subsection may be construed as superseding any other remedy available for the unauthorized disclosure of confidential information.

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or funding changes are stated in the source text.

Amends title 35, United States Code, to mandate a new interagency task force, memorandums of understanding, mandatory information requests during patent examinations, and a reporting requirement to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 35, United States Code, to establish an interagency task force between the United States Patent and Trademark Office and the Food and Drug Administration

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent interagency coordination mechanisms alongside a specific reporting requirement due four years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 4 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary of Commerce for Intellectual Property and Director... shall submit... a report

missing_information: Any cost estimates or funding required to operate the task force are omitted from the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes an Interagency Task Force on Patents between the USPTO and the FDA to coordinate information sharing, technical assistance, and patent examination processes for human drugs and biological products.
